description: This file contains unit tests for the HasFieldErrors matcher class, verifying its behavior when matching validation errors on fields within the OpenMRS notification alert system.

classes.name: HasFieldErrorsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the HasFieldErrors matcher, testing various scenarios for matching field errors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test objects before each test execution.

methods.name: shouldAppendFieldErrorsDescriptionIfFieldAndCodeAreNull
methods.description: Verifies description output when no specific field or code is specified.

methods.name: shouldAppendNoErrorForSpecificFieldIfFieldIsNonNull
methods.description: Checks description output when a specific field is targeted.

methods.name: shouldAppendNoErrorForSpecificFieldAndCodeIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNull
methods.description: Checks description output when both field and code are specified.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNullAndGivenErrorHasNoFieldErrors
methods.description: Ensures matching fails when no errors are present but criteria is for field errors.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNullAndGivenErrorHasFieldErrors
methods.description: Ensures matching succeeds when errors are present and no specific field or code is targeted.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldIsNonNullAndGivenErrorDoesNotHaveFieldErrors
methods.description: Checks that matching fails when specific field errors are required but missing.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldIsNonNullButNotContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Verifies that match fails when errors exist but not on the specified field.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldIsNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Verifies matching succeeds when errors on the specific field are present.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndGivenErrorDoesNotHaveFieldErrors
methods.description: Checks that matching fails when specific field and code are required but error does not match both.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndGivenErrorsDoesNotContainSpecificErrorCode
methods.description: Ensures failure when error codes do not match the expected code.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndGivenErrorsDoesNotContainSpecificField
methods.description: Ensures failure when errors are on other fields but not the specified one.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrorsWithASingleFieldError
methods.description: Verifies success when the error code matches the specific field error.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrorsWithMultipleFieldErrors
methods.description: Verifies success when multiple errors on the field include the specified code.
